question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
-- Calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021
WITH unicorn_companies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cf.company_id
    FROM companies_funding cf
    WHERE cf.valuation >= 1000000000
),
new_unicorns_2019_2021 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cd.company_id, cd.year_founded, ci.industry
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN unicorn_companies uc ON cd.company_id = uc.company_id
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    WHERE cd.year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
),
top_industry AS (
    SELECT industry
    FROM new_unicorns_2019_2021
    GROUP BY industry
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_industry_counts AS (
    SELECT nu.year_founded, COUNT(*) as count
    FROM new_unicorns_2019_2021 nu
    JOIN top_industry ti ON nu.industry = ti.industry
    GROUP BY nu.year_founded
)
SELECT AVG(1.0 * count) as avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM top_industry_counts;
